content: UR cobots do NOT satisfy Pieper's principle (3 consecutive joint axes intersecting at one point) so a fully generic closed-form solution is nontrivial, though practical closed-form UR IK solvers exist in the community (e.g. ur-kinematics libraries) exploiting the UR-specific geometry. Any 6-DOF IK generally yields up to 8 valid joint solutions for a reachable pose (shoulder left/right x elbow up/down x wrist flip); must pick one deterministically (e.g. closest to previous joint config) or animation will jump/flip unpredictably. Unreachable poses (outside workspace envelope or violating joint limits) must be explicitly detected and rejected rather than silently clamped.
